name: CMIP6 piClim-aer and piClim-control simulations
model_or_instrument: Multiple CMIP6 GCMs (CESM2, CanESM5, GFDL-CM4, HadGEM3-GC31-LL, CNRM-CM6-1, CNRM-ESM2-1, IPSL-CM6A-LR)
access: CMIP6 data is available through the Earth System Grid Federation (CMIP6 Earth System Grid Federation, 2023).

scales.note: CMIP6 piClim-aer and piClim-control 30-year integrations across multiple GCMs evaluated as monthly mean output.
